        }
    }

        }
    }

    is_valid = { has_variable_list = DI_dm_selected }
    effect = {
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_player

        set_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count value = 0 }
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_dm_selected
            DI_dm_set_japanese_roastery_02_effect = yes
        }
    }
}

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_dm_selected
            DI_dm_set_school_seminary_03_effect = yes
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_chain_camp_baggage_train_06_sgui = {
    scope = character
    is_valid = { has_variable_list = DI_dm_selected }
    effect = {
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_player
        DI_dm_refresh_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = DI_dm_building_level } var:DI_dm_building_level = 1 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_baggage_train_01_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 2 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_baggage_train_02_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 3 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_baggage_train_03_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 4 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_baggage_train_04_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 5 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_baggage_train_05_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { OR = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 0 var:DI_dm_building_level >= 6 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_baggage_train_06_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_barber_tent_02_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 3 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_barber_tent_03_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 4 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_barber_tent_04_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 5 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_barber_tent_05_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { OR = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 0 var:DI_dm_building_level >= 6 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_barber_tent_06_effect = yes

DI_dm_chain_camp_camp_fire_06_sgui = {
    scope = character
    is_valid = { has_variable_list = DI_dm_selected }
    effect = {
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_player
        DI_dm_refresh_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = DI_dm_building_level } var:DI_dm_building_level = 1 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_camp_fire_01_effect = yes
            }

        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 2 }
            every_in_list = {

                DI_dm_set_camp_fire_02_effect = yes

        else_if = {

            every_in_list = {

                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_camp_fire_04_effect = yes
            }

        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 5 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_camp_fire_05_effect = yes
            }

        else_if = {

                variable = DI_dm_selected

DI_dm_chain_camp_supply_tent_06_sgui = {
    scope = character
    is_valid = { has_variable_list = DI_dm_selected }
    effect = {
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_player
        DI_dm_refresh_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = DI_dm_building_level } var:DI_dm_building_level = 1 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_supply_tent_01_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 2 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_supply_tent_02_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 3 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_supply_tent_03_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 4 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_supply_tent_04_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 5 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_supply_tent_05_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { OR = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 0 var:DI_dm_building_level >= 6 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_supply_tent_06_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_chain_east_asian_estate_east_asian_estate_cartography_office_04_sgui = {
    scope = character
    is_valid = { has_variable_list = DI_dm_selected }
    effect = {
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_player
        DI_dm_refresh_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = DI_dm_building_level } var:DI_dm_building_level = 1 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_east_asian_estate_cartography_office_01_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 2 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_east_asian_estate_cartography_office_02_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 3 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_east_asian_estate_cartography_office_03_effect = yes
            }

        else_if = {
            limit = { OR = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 0 var:DI_dm_building_level >= 4 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_east_asian_estate_cartography_office_04_effect = yes
            }

    }

    is_valid = { OR = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 0 var:DI_dm_building_level >= 4 } }
}

DI_dm_chain_ecclesiastical_domicile_archives_cartulary_vault_04_sgui = {
    scope = character
    is_valid = { has_variable_list = DI_dm_selected }
    effect = {
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_player
        DI_dm_refresh_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = DI_dm_building_level } var:DI_dm_building_level = 1 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_archives_cartulary_vault_01_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 2 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_archives_cartulary_vault_02_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 3 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_archives_cartulary_vault_03_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { OR = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 0 var:DI_dm_building_level >= 4 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_archives_cartulary_vault_04_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

            limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = DI_dm_building_level } var:DI_dm_building_level = 1 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_guard_tower_drill_yard_01_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 2 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected

    is_valid = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 3 }
}

DI_dm_chain_ecclesiastical_domicile_school_seminary_04_level_4_sgui = {
    scope = character
    is_valid = { OR = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 0 var:DI_dm_building_level >= 4 } }
}

DI_dm_chain_ecclesiastical_domicile_school_seminary_04_sgui = {
    scope = character
    is_valid = { has_variable_list = DI_dm_selected }
    effect = {
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_player
        DI_dm_refresh_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = DI_dm_building_level } var:DI_dm_building_level = 1 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_school_seminary_01_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 2 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_school_seminary_02_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 3 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_school_seminary_03_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { OR = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 0 var:DI_dm_building_level >= 4 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_school_seminary_04_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_remove_chain_ecclesiastical_domicile_school_seminary_04_sgui = {

DI_dm_chain_estate_stable_grand_06_level_6_sgui = {
    scope = character
    is_valid = { OR = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 0 var:DI_dm_building_level >= 6 } }
}

DI_dm_chain_estate_stable_grand_06_sgui = {
    scope = character
    is_valid = { has_variable_list = DI_dm_selected }
    effect = {
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_player
        DI_dm_refresh_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = DI_dm_building_level } var:DI_dm_building_level = 1 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_stable_01_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 2 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_stable_02_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 3 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_stable_03_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 4 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_stable_grand_04_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 5 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_stable_grand_05_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { OR = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 0 var:DI_dm_building_level >= 6 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_stable_grand_06_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

    scope = character
    is_valid = { has_variable_list = DI_dm_selected }
    effect = {
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_player

DI_dm_chain_japanese_manor_japanese_koshu_cellars_06_level_6_sgui = {
    scope = character
    is_valid = { OR = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 0 var:DI_dm_building_level >= 6 } }
}

DI_dm_chain_japanese_manor_japanese_koshu_cellars_06_sgui = {
    scope = character
    is_valid = { has_variable_list = DI_dm_selected }
    effect = {
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_player
        DI_dm_refresh_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = DI_dm_building_level } var:DI_dm_building_level = 1 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_japanese_koshu_cellars_01_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 2 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_japanese_koshu_cellars_02_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 3 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_japanese_koshu_cellars_03_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 4 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_japanese_koshu_cellars_04_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 5 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_japanese_koshu_cellars_05_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { OR = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 0 var:DI_dm_building_level >= 6 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_japanese_koshu_cellars_06_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_chain_yurt_raiding_yurt_06_sgui = {
    scope = character
    is_valid = { has_variable_list = DI_dm_selected }
    effect = {
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_player
        DI_dm_refresh_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = DI_dm_building_level } var:DI_dm_building_level = 1 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_raiding_yurt_01_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 2 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_raiding_yurt_02_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 3 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_raiding_yurt_03_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 4 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_raiding_yurt_04_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 5 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_raiding_yurt_05_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { OR = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 0 var:DI_dm_building_level >= 6 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_raiding_yurt_06_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

    is_valid = { has_variable_list = DI_dm_selected }
    effect = {
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_player
        DI_dm_refresh_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = DI_dm_building_level } var:DI_dm_building_level = 1 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_tributary_yurt_01_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 2 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_tributary_yurt_02_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 3 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_tributary_yurt_03_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 4 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_tributary_yurt_04_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 5 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_tributary_yurt_05_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { OR = { var:DI_dm_building_level = 0 var:DI_dm_building_level >= 6 } }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = DI_dm_selected
                DI_dm_set_tributary_yurt_06_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_dm_remove_chain_yurt_tributary_yurt_06_sgui = {
    scope = character
    is_valid = { has_variable_list = DI_dm_selected }
    effect = {
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_player
        DI_dm_refresh_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = DI_dm_changed_count value = 0 }
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_dm_selected
            if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = tributary_yurt_06 }
                DI_dm_remove_tributary_yurt_06_effect = yes
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = tributary_yurt_05 }
                DI_dm_remove_tributary_yurt_05_effect = yes
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = tributary_yurt_04 }
                DI_dm_remove_tributary_yurt_04_effect = yes
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = tributary_yurt_03 }
                DI_dm_remove_tributary_yurt_03_effect = yes
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = tributary_yurt_02 }

            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_domicile_building = tributary_yurt_01 }

            }
        }
    }

DI_dm_apply_filter_sgui = {
    scope = character
    saved_scopes = { filter_choice }
    is_valid = { OR = {
        scope:filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_all
        scope:filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_camp
        scope:filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_east_asian_estate
        scope:filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_ecclesiastical_domicile
        scope:filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_estate
        scope:filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_japanese_manor
        scope:filter_choice = flag:DI_dm_filter_type_yurt
    } }
    effect = {
        save_scope_as = DI_dm_player
        DI_dm_ensure_filter_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = DI_dm_filter_choice value = scope:filter_choice }
        DI_dm_refresh_effect = yes
    }
}
